designReview.evidence: Independently reviewed the R2 roadmap-sync proposal in two rounds against owner decisions 103 and 104, the roadmap source, and schema-v2 record requirements. The first round identified private firmware-check details in the public record, an overbroad merged-PR range, invalid draft admission fields, and a blob misidentified as HEAD; all four were corrected. The second round identified one additional overstatement: decision 103 makes the standing reminders applicable at the 1.2.0 release but does not exclude their application at every 1.1.x release. The proposed roadmap text was corrected to remove that exclusion. The amended release model preserves full GitHub publication of intermediate 1.1.x versions, the historical 1.1.10 numbering decision, and the existing Launcher and reference-refresh allocations. The R2 governance classification, roadmap-only mutable path, and bounded terminal contract are appropriate. Findings are incorporated; admission and final implementation verification remain separate gates.
